title: IAEA Live Chart: 14C half-life 5700 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 14C lists half-life 5700 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 30 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 14C (Z=6, N=8), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 5700, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 30, half_life_sec 179874478055.1744, and unc_hls 946707779.23776. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 30 years. The unc_hl value 30 is that same absolute uncertainty of 30 years. The leading decay field is B- at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 1-JUL-1990. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 14C
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.
Removed a clause that said the uncertainty was not the absolute number of years. For this row unc_hl matches the seconds column as that many years.
